meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: Claude 会组建一个 5 人安全团队（3 名漏洞猎手和 2 名 PoC 工程师），并行审计代码库，验证漏洞的可利用性，分类根本原因，并根据实际可利用性校准严重性。最终输出一份安全研究报告，包含判定、发现列表和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求进行安全审查、漏洞研究、可利用性审计、发布前安全检查、威胁模型验证，或说出“security-research”、“security review”、“vulnerability audit”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请对这个仓库做一次安全审查。
say.note: Claude 会启动团队模式，并行审计当前仓库。

say.text: 审计这个 PR 的 diff，找出可利用的漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会基于变更代码进行针对性审计。

say.text: 检查当前分支与主分支的差异，发现安全风险。
say.note: Claude 会对比分支差异并执行审计。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates a 5-member security team (3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel, verify exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity based on actual exploitability. Outputs a security research report with verdict, findings, and fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, or use keywords like 'security-research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit'.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on this repository.
say_en.note: Claude starts team mode and audits the current repo.

say_en.text: Audit this PR diff for exploitable vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude focuses on the changed code.

say_en.text: Check the diff between current branch and main for security risks.
say_en.note: Claude compares branches and runs the audit.
